services.desc: To Rent the hall you need proof of insurance, a cleaning deposit and payment of Fee. Application must be submitted 30 days prior to event. Deposits and fees paid up front. Cleaning deposit returned after inspection following use. Chairs and Tables are also available for rental offsite. $1 per chair, $7.00 per 8 ' white plastic
